# E0705: overlapping edits

Two edits can't change the same code. Make them one edit. Nothing was written.

- Rule: [`edits.refusals`](../../reference/19-tools.md#edits.refusals)
- Reported at: the address of the later of the two edits, in the command line.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `refusal` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0705_declaration_and_its_body.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0705_declaration_and_its_body.lt):

`E0705_declaration_and_its_body.lt`:

```stilt fragment
/// Totals what the orders sold.
fn totals(orders: List<i64>) -> i64 {
  var sum = 0
  for qty in orders {
    sum += qty
  }
  sum
}
```

`E0705_declaration_and_its_body.edits`, beside it:

```text
main.totals#f9d9
fn totals(orders: List<i64>) -> i64 { 0 }
main.totals/body#45bc
{ 0 }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── OVERLAPPING EDITS ───────────────────────────────────── command line  [E0705]

Two edits change `main.totals`: one replaces the declaration, and the other its
body:

  --edit 'main.totals#f9d9' 'fn totals(orders: List<i64>) -> i64 { 0 …' --edit 'main.totals/body#45bc' '{ 0 }'
          ────────────────
                                                                                ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Two edits can't change the same code. Make them one edit. Nothing was written.
```
